MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, date(replace(p.birth_date, '/', '-')) AS birth_date, date('2026-10-14') AS reference_date
WITH p,
     date_part('year', reference_date) - date_part('year', birth_date) - CASE
       WHEN date_part('month', reference_date) < date_part('month', birth_date)
         OR (date_part('month', reference_date) = date_part('month', birth_date)
             AND date_part('day', reference_date) < date_part('day', birth_date))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
WHERE age <= 78
   OR p.current_team = 'Capitanes de Arecibo'
   OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0
   OR CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN contains(p.birth_date, ',')
    THEN date_part('year', strptime(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y'))
    ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN contains(p.birth_date, ',')
    THEN date_part('month', strptime(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y'))
    ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN contains(p.birth_date, ',')
    THEN date_part('day', strptime(p.birth_date, '%B %d, %Y'))
    ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_day
WITH p,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE
    WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE age <= 78
   OR p.current_team = 'Capitanes de Arecibo'
   OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0
   OR CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN contains(p.birth_date, ',') THEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 3) AS INT64)
    ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN contains(p.birth_date, ',') THEN CASE split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 1)
      WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4
      WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8
      WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
    END
    ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE
    WHEN contains(p.birth_date, ',') THEN CAST(rtrim(split_part(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',') AS INT64)
    ELSE CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_day
WITH p, 2026 - birth_year - CASE
  WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS age
WHERE age <= 78
   OR p.current_team = 'Capitanes de Arecibo'
   OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0
   OR CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1
RETURN p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player
